p: This beach might be the least famous beach in Busan. It is right next to Nakdong river, so it has very soft sand and the water is very shallow. There are small park, fountains, locker room, and small benches for watching the sunset.…
A scenic rocky headland with walking trails and a dense forest. It's a great spot for a hike with views of the sea, Dadaepo Beach, and nearby islands.
Show times vary by season. Check the official website for schedules.
A spectacular musical fountain show with lights and water jets. It's a popular attraction, especially in the evening, as it's located right on Dadaepo Beach.
Offers hoe (raw fish/sashimi) and seafood sets. The location provides a view of the ocean.

This restaurant specializes in seolleongtang (ox bone soup), which is characterized by its white, milky broth from hours of slow cooking. The soup is usually served with rice and minimal seasoning, allowing diners to adjust the flavor…

Specializes in sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew). The stew is served boiling hot and can be customized with seafood or meat, accompanied by traditional side dishes. Popular as a simple breakfast or lunch option.
A casual bar offering a selection of beer and mixed drinks. Its location is utilized to provide sunset views over Dadaepo Beach, particularly popular before or after the fountain show.
A small bar that offers a curated selection of global wines, sold by the glass or bottle. It provides a quieter, more upscale alternative to the neighboring beer and soju spots.
